verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents its own local and self-hosted installs: a one-line installer, Docker Compose, and a single container with an embedded database for one machine. A developer can therefore run workflows on a local or dev instance. Nothing in the pack covers CI testing, such as headless flow execution, a test runner or CLI, or promoting flows between environments. A community report also notes that dev-setup instructions were missing. missing for 10: CI test execution of flows, CLI or headless run tooling, dev-to-prod environment promotion docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run workflows locally or against a dev instance for development and CI testing

citations.quote: Single container with an embedded database, for personal use on one machine
One line writes the config, generates your secrets, and starts everything.
